score_definitions.market_screening_score: mean of available category scores; not used for category ranking
score_definitions.early_move_score: market-wide quantitative early-change score; separate from formal Technical
score_definitions.market_discovery_score: fundamental improvement plus non-overheated price score
score_definitions.discovery_score: public alias of market_discovery_score; not thematic discovery_score
score_definitions.value_growth_score: growth, profitability, simple valuation and non-overheat score

data_sources.market: Yahoo Finance chart; split-adjusted OHLC, not dividend-total-return adjusted
data_sources.fundamentals: Yahoo Japan pages; secondary screening input
data_sources.trading_value: estimated as close times volume; not official turnover value

notes: Candidates with category coverage below 60% are excluded from that category ranking.
Missing values remain null and are never inferred.
value_trap_risk remains UNKNOWN unless observed deterioration supports MEDIUM or HIGH.
Formal watchlist addition requires detailed analysis and human approval.
